newsitem.title: UK: British farmers welcome EU reform plan.
newsitem.headline: British farmers welcome EU reform plan.

text.p: A British farmers group has given a qualified welcome to proposals, known as Agenda 2000, for further reform of the EU's Common Agricultural Policy.

"Despite our many misgivings over the details of the Commission's proposals, there is no doubt that the commodity specific proposals of Agenda 2000 will help us achieve the all important move towards the market place," England and Wales National Farmers Union president Sir David Naish said in a statement.
He stressed that the NFU would insist compensation payments were significantly improved to cover farmers' losses from cuts in support prices.
The European Commission unveiled proposals on Wednesday for further price-cutting farm reforms to prepare for expansion eastwards and prevent the return of costly food mountains.
The proposals reinforce 1992 reforms to make European farmers more competitive by lowering prices towards world levels and shifting support for agriculture to direct payments to farmers.
